summary: Embedding handshake: dynamic-dimension negotiation causing sporadic rerank timeouts and degraded top-k consistency
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports intermittent timeouts and inconsistent top-k results from /v1/rerank when embedding requests are proxied through our edge. Behavior appears after a rolling proxy upgrade earlier this week.

Impact:
- Several requests from AtlasDocs experience 5-10% failure rate for rerank endpoint with 504/timeout or partial result sets.
- For successful responses, top-k ordering sometimes differs vs baseline run (same vectors) causing production ranking regressions.
- Business impact: search relevance drops for paid users; customer flagged as P1 and asked for urgent mitigation.

Environment:
- Customer uses Dedicated capacity in us-west and eu-west.
- Embedding client negotiates dynamic vector dim header via embed-dim handshake.
- Traffic flows: AtlasDocs -> edge-proxy (TLS) -> embeddings-api -> reranker-service -> ann-index.

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1) Send batch of 8 text -> /v1/embeddings (model embed-gen-1024) with client header X-Embed-Dim: auto
2) Proxy occasionally rewrites or strips dimension metadata to downstream (trace shows missing X-Embed-Dim for subset)
3) /v1/rerank receives embeddings with inferred shape; reranker fast-path expects pinned dim 1024, but sees inconsistent dims, triggering a compatibility fallback path that serializes to a slower CPU/FP32 path and sometimes times out under load.
4) When fallback path triggers mid-batch, partial results produced and ann-index queries return mismatched candidate sets -> top-k reorder observed.

Logs / Observations:
- Edge proxy (envoy) traces: tls-stream-xx trace IDs show header drop on ~7% of batches between 2025-11-06 23:10 - 23:45 UTC.
- embeddings-api logs: "WARN embed.handshake: missing-dim-header, infer_dim=512" for affected requests.
- reranker-service metrics: rerank_latency_p50 up 3x for flows where embed.dim inferred vs pinned; rerank_5xx spike to 1.6%.
- Ann index traces: queries issued with shape (512) to index pre-sharded for 1024 vectors causing candidate mismatch warnings in index logs.

Hypothesis:
- The proxy upgrade introduced a streaming/multipart patch that conditionally strips or normalizes non-standard headers (X-Embed-Dim), causing some requests to lose explicit dimension metadata.
- Reranker service tries to be permissive: it infers dims and falls back to a CPU/compat path to avoid outright error; under high concurrency that path is much slower and leads to timeouts and inconsistent candidate selection.

Immediate mitigation attempted:
- Support applied an emergency proxy rule in us-west to preserve X-Embed-Dim header for customer traffic (temporary bypass).
- Requested customer to pin client to embed-gen-512 for next 6 hours as a quick config change to avoid dimension negotiation in-flight.
- Increased reranker CPU fallback timeout to 6s in a canary ASG.

Next steps / plan:
- SRE to roll an Envoy config rollback for the streaming header normalization for all customers in us-west (blocked until change window).
- Engineering to add strict schema validation at embeddings-api: reject requests without explicit dimension header when model requires pinned dim OR include explicit negotiation response so downstream services can rely on it.
- Reranker team to change fallback behavior: prefer deterministic reject (429) over silent CPU fallback when dim mismatch detected for pinned-models, to avoid returning partial/incorrect top-k.
- Create a short-term patch to ensure embedding responses include explicit embed-dim header in response payload.

Files / traces / links:
- Proxy trace sample: trace-id tls-stream-88a2 (attached in ticket)
- Embeddings API log snippet: logs/embed-handshake-2025-11-06.txt (attached)
- Runbook reference: Embed Handshake Runbook (confluence link above)

resolution_notes: Workarounds in place: proxy preserve-header rule for AtlasDocs in us-west; customer instructed to pin embed-gen-512 temporarily. Engineering patch (PR #2145) adds explicit embed-dim header to embeddings-api responses on canary. Reranker change to prefer deterministic reject on dim mismatch is targeted for 2025-11-12 deployment. Full rollback of proxy header normalization scheduled 2025-11-11.
investigation_notes: Checked proxy changelog: envoy build 1.23.5 introduced normalize_trailing_headers filter that was enabled via bootstrap flag in the upgrade; that filter removes headers matching pattern X-* unless allowlist present. Confirmed missing allowlist entry for X-Embed-Dim. Local repro uses curl with accepted header then simulates proxy filter and reproduces missing header. Index mismatch warnings indicate ann shard routing keyed on vector length, so inconsistent length changes candidate partitioning. Suggested long-term fix: decouple shard routing from vector-dim where possible or include explicit metadata in index routing key.
next_steps: 1) Rollback envoy normalization in us-west during approved window (SRE). 2) Merge and roll out embeddings-api patch to emit embed-dim header (Eng). 3) Reranker to change fallback to 429 for pinned-model dim mismatch and add monitoring alert (Reranker Team). 4) Postmortem and recommended proxy allowlist update to prevent header stripping across customers (Ops).
customer_visible_message: We're actively addressing an issue where some embedding requests lose the dimension metadata in transit, which can cause slower reranks or inconsistent results. We've applied temporary measures to preserve the header for your traffic and recommend pinning a 512-dim model as a short-term mitigation. We'll follow up with a permanent fix and keep you updated.
public_priority_note: Internal priority P1 / Sev1 due to live customer impact on search relevance for paid users.
